ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first health awareness app tailored for rural Indian communities to provide preventive healthcare and vaccination schedules.
ideas.title: GramSwasthya AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds upon the success pattern of SAGACITY by addressing local socio-economic challenges in India with an accessible voice and multilingual interface, which heavily appeals to regional offline hackathon judges.

ideas.pitch: A real-time disaster management and emergency resource coordination platform mapped specifically for urban and semi-urban regions like Indore.
ideas.title: DisasterWatch Indore
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the success pattern of Oarfin by delivering a concrete, map-based, live tool for emergency response that judges can interact with instantly during the offline science fair-style judging.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and meal recommendation platform customized for hostel students eating at mess facilities across Indian colleges.
ideas.title: NutriTrack Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant by targeting a relatable daily problem for college students with a highly polished visual UI and rapid AI API integration.

ideas.pitch: An enterprise video indexing and retrieval platform that transforms unstructured lecture or meeting recordings into searchable text segments.
ideas.title: DocuSearch Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopted from LibrAI's multi-award-winning approach, offering a high-utility productivity tool that solves a universal data overload pain point with a guaranteed working demo.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI assistant for college student placement cells and club leads to schedule interviews, draft reports, and automate administrative overhead.
ideas.title: CampusBot AI Chief of Staff
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the autonomous agent framework seen in claw-chief-of-staff to a hyper-local college environment, making it immediately resonant with faculty judges from the host institution.
